entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this piece of junk jersey I bought. This is absolutely ridiculous, I've been on hold for ten minutes!
I do apologize for the wait time, sir. I can certainly look into a return for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

What kind of a stupid question is that? The issue is that it's the wrong size! It's way too tight. I want to do an exchange or just get my money back. Now are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager?
I understand your frustration, and there's no need for a manager, I can handle this for you right here. Let me just pull up your order. Can I get your name and order number, please?

The name is Mike Schmidt. Order number is VF-789012. You'd better not give me any trouble on this. I know your policy says 90 days and I'll post a review on every website you're on if you try to deny this.

Thank you, Mike. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the ProFit Jersey, delivered 76 days ago. And you are correct, sir. This item is well within our 90-day return window. I can process that for you right now.
So you're just... approving it? No fight?

That's correct. There's no reason to deny it. You're eligible for a full refund or an exchange. I've just emailed a pre-paid return label to the address on file. You can simply pack the jersey up and drop it off. Would you prefer the refund, or would you like me to set up the exchange for a larger size?
Oh. Uh... just the refund is fine. I'll handle it from there. Send the label.

It has already been sent, you should see it in your inbox shortly. Once we receive the item, we'll process your refund within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mike?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
